execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a surviving MSAS tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries it through implementation, required validation, verified closeout and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected surviving tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated provider archaeology and other-family work.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute target for focused validation, evidence verification, reconciliation and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: Split before governed start if a surviving tranche cannot credibly preserve the closeout reserve.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; require changed evidence before retry.

boundaries: AAI remains audio asset, cue, soundscape, provider, playback, layering/mixer, availability, event-binding, permission, remote-sync, recording/streaming and interoperability authority
DWC speech retains constructed-language pronunciation, exact-ID and governed acoustic-model authority
ARI retains audio resource identity, bytes/reference state, rights/use capability and derivative lineage
PCA-07 supplies reusable adaptive-audio authoring/profiling, preview and performance/loudness primitives; MSAS productizes them into the integrated creator workflow
PCA-08 supplies reusable voice/speech/SFX production primitives and ARI registration; MSAS owns domain production UX and semantic binding
PCA-09 owns generic provider-neutral generation orchestration; historical MSAS-17 survives only as domain adapters inside MSAS-05/07/12/18
PCA-13 owns generic localization-production infrastructure; MSAS-12 owns audio/voice localization binding and review
PDCP Packet 07 owns generic preview/dry-run/commit/explanation/intervention/debug/recovery semantics; MSAS-15 provides only audio-domain live-GM control
World, Environment, Scene, Adventure, Combat, Dialogue and Action/Event owners retain canonical state and event authority
prepared cue mappings, adaptive states, soundboard triggers and simulated transitions never prove that a gameplay event occurred
generic DAW/DSP/codec/plugin-hosting/mastering capabilities should use lawful mature replaceable libraries/tools where practical instead of rebuilding general-purpose applications
voice identity and cloning require explicit consent/right evidence and cannot silently impersonate another person
all imported/generated audio resources and derivatives preserve ARI provenance and rights evidence
optional generated music, sound or voice remains candidate content until explicit acceptance and binding
meaningful spoken/sonic information requires caption/transcript or non-audio semantic alternatives where applicable
unsupported imports, middleware features and round-trip semantics remain explicit rather than fabricated
no paid/cloud audio or voice provider is required for blocking workflows
proprietary benchmark products remain clean-room planning provenance only
MRCS is the strict planned successor after MSAS-21 and consumes audio references/bindings without absorbing AAI/MSAS authority
no MSAS implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a surviving MSAS work item
